verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents bulk import into AuthKit from existing sources, including a CLI migration tool that packages users, organizations, memberships, roles and SSO handoff files from Auth0. The 'export' step in those docs means exporting out of Auth0, not out of WorkOS. Nothing in the pack documents importing password hashes or exporting users back out of WorkOS; the community lock-in concern is an open question, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: documented password-hash import, documented user export out of WorkOS, coverage of non-Auth0 sources in detail, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import existing users — including password hashes — and export them again, so I am never locked in

citations.quote: The WorkOS AuthKit API allows you to migrate your existing user data from a variety of existing sources.
This produces a migration package with users, organizations, memberships, roles, SSO handoff files, and warnings.
The fastest way to export Auth0 data is with the WorkOS CLI migrations tool
